_note: Release contract (T0.6). release.yml publishes `release.version` once: when CI is green on main and the tag v<version> does not exist yet, and only if app/build.gradle carries the same versionName/versionCode. null = nothing to release. Asset names stay version-free so README links to releases/latest work; the tag carries the version. `fully_tested: false` adds the 'not fully tested yet' line to the notes (INBOX #3: intermediate releases before the one full test pass).

release.notes_extra: Changes since v1.0.0 (fully tested, full emulator pass 55/55), from the owner's first phone test: the quality picker shows each option's size and only the resolutions the video has; the battery-optimization request appears at most once and never when it is already off; new installs download to the public Downloads folder. Checked by the fast gates and the short emulator traffic test; the long full test was not rerun because no download or chain code changed.

methods_per_abi._note: Fallback methods per ABI (Q8 = A: new natives on 64-bit only). CI and release.yml check every APK against this with tools/release/method_matrix.py; the universal APK carries each ABI's set.

method_natives._note: native libraries a method runs in lib/<abi>/ (S, W and H hand media streams to yt-dlp; ffmpeg merges and remuxes); methods not listed run on every ABI (Java/Kotlin or WebView)
